verdict.rationale: LiveKit provides a documented, Apache-2.0 open-source self-hosting deployment guide including embedded TURN server and SSL setup, and this was hands-on verified: `livekit-server --dev` boots with no account or key, and the open-source livekit-agents framework installs and imports keylessly via pip/npm. This directly demonstrates the core product (server + agents framework) can be self-hosted. Missing for 10: independent third-party production self-hosting case study beyond the probe verification.
